settings._title: Inside, a soaring foyer, dramatic upper
settings.editor: Inside, a soaring foyer, dramatic upper catwalk, oak hardwood floors with decorative inlay, custom millwork and abundant natural light set the tone. The two-story living room showcases a floor-to-ceiling stacked-stone gas fireplace and architectural window wall overlooking the grounds, with doors opening to the expansive covered deck and BBQ area.

settings._title: The well-appointed kitchen features a la
settings.editor: The well-appointed kitchen features a large center island, extensive cabinetry, walk-in pantry, KitchenAid appliances, five-burner gas cooktop with retractable downdraft ventilation and a window wall capturing territorial and Mt. Hood views.
Open space, mature landscaping, natural rock features and usable acreage create opportunities for recreation, gardening, animals, hobbies or simply more room to breathe.

settings._title: The 2,304 SF barn is set on a 48’ x 48’
settings.editor: The 2,304 SF barn is set on a 48’ x 48’ concrete pad and features two 12’ x 12’ stalls, seven Dutch doors, hay loft, large sliding doors and covered side aisles. Equipped with power and water, the barn also includes a bathroom with shower and a workshop area with refrigerator, counter space and built-in shelving.

settings._title: The heated 435 SF building offers 11’ ce
settings.editor: The heated 435 SF building offers 11’ ceilings, commercial-grade flooring, full-light French doors, custom wood counters and cabinetry, pull-out workspace, lumber rack, compressed-air quick-connect fittings, dedicated electrical panel and abundant natural light.

An impressive 1,498 SF detached structure includes an oversized 3-car garage plus a two-story-high RV bay capable of accommodating a 40' RV. The RV bay has an indoor electrical hookup, while the exterior RV driveway provides an additional full RV hookup. A covered breezeway connects the garage to the home.

Professionally landscaped and irrigated grounds, a custom water feature with natural boulders and architectural stone centerpiece, expansive covered rear deck and covered outdoor fire pit create inviting spaces to enjoy the quiet Wine Country setting.
